result.question: how do I bridge to Solana from Pharos?
result.answer:
The Pharos docs don’t list a supported **Pharos ↔ Solana** bridge route. The documented [Chainlink CCIP](/tooling-and-infrastructure/cross-chain/chainlink-ccip) are Ethereum, Jovay, Polygon, and Base.

Pharos also documents [LayerZero](/tooling-and-infrastructure/cross-chain/layerzero) and [Circle CCTP](/tooling-and-infrastructure/cross-chain/circle-cctp), but their Pharos pages don’t specify a Solana route or user transfer steps. I can’t confirm a way to bridge from Pharos to Solana from the available docs.
